episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: While Chester catches the attention of the school's new guidance counselor, Greta learns she can't sneak anything past her aunt. After secrets drive Nathan and his twin Naomi apart, he hopes Chester can turn his awful evening around.

episodes.title: Dickscovery
episodes.summary: The chaos of Club Fair Day is unexpectedly interrupted, forcing the teens to reckon with some difficult truths. Later, just as Naomi decides to take her relationship with Jack to the next level, she makes a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Toasted
episodes.summary: Nathan's guilt over what happened with Naomi manifests in a very public declaration, while Chester, Riley and Greta sneak into an aquarium to get high. Later, Nathan once again forces Chester to play hero.

episodes.title: Pussy Power
episodes.summary: Chester angles to land himself in Sam's office, only to struggle with the guidance he's given. Megan grapples with the rapidly evolving world. Naomi and Arianna help their friend through her highly unconventional birth.

episodes.title: Gays and Confused
episodes.summary: When school shuts down, Chester, Riley and Greta spend a blissful and intimate day together. With Chester distracted by a chance encounter with Sam, Greta and Riley explore a deeper level of their relationship.

episodes.title: The Wheels on the Bussy
episodes.summary: The GSA embarks on their long-awaited trip to San Francisco. Greta and Riley navigate a new awkwardness, Nathan and Naomi turn a fun game into a merciless sibling takedown, and Sam moves his questions for Chester offline.

episodes.title: Desert Island
episodes.summary: On the way to San Francisco, Nathan and Arianna are forced to navigate an awkward truth, Riley and Greta struggle to connect, and Chester's admission to Sam sends them both spiraling.

episodes.title: The Last Shall Be First
episodes.summary: Chester recovers from his misfire with Sam, Naomi inadvertently shares a private video with her entire family, and Delilah leans on her friends for help making the most important decision of her life.

episodes.title: Deepfake
episodes.summary: Back at school, Greta and Riley navigate lingering weirdness from their trip, while Delilah and Naomi fall for the same guy in French class. After Chester's frenzied first date with Bo, Nathan makes him an offer he can't refuse.

episodes.title: Built for Pleasure
episodes.summary: As Chester goes above and beyond to fulfill "boyfriend" duties, Nathan returns the favor. Greta finds herself caught between family time and a new connection with Luz, while Delilah keeps Riley close for an unconventional date with Cooper.

episodes.title: Absolute Zero
episodes.summary: Struggling to manage her stress, Riley pours herself into a job search, discovering a true ally in Ana. While Greta and Luz establish boundaries, Chester and Bo find a spark. Later, Greta's family dinner is full of surprises.

episodes.title: The High Priestess
episodes.summary: At Arianna's sleepover, a potentially devastating secret helps inspire a solution to Delilah and Naomi's romantic dilemma.

episodes.title: There's Something About Hamburger Mary's
episodes.summary: After Nathan relocates their mother-son date night to a fundraiser for queer youth, Megan is forced out of her comfort zone. Meanwhile, Nathan drives a wedge between Chester and Bo, and Greta questions her romantic decisions.

episodes.title: Click Whirr
episodes.summary: After her father drops a bombshell, a sleep-deprived Riley finds herself at odds with Greta and Ana, dodging Sam, and in desperate need of an MIA Chester. Meanwhile, Naomi's dental procedure wreaks havoc on more than just her mouth.

episodes.title: L'Amour
episodes.summary: Mark's Valentine's Day party for the teens has an unexpected effect on his wife. After untangling their relationship from Nathan, Chester and Bo land in Megan's crosshairs. Riley and Greta work up the courage to level with each other.

episodes.title: V-Day
episodes.summary: Valentine's Day puts love, truth, and friendships to the test as Riley struggles to put out the overwhelming fires around her, Cooper pushes Delilah towards honesty, and Chester and Nathan's relationship comes full circle.
